# Kurzschwert

A weapon: the kind under the right icon picks the crossed swords, the
label / value block holds the weapon's three lines and the price, the
flavour sits at the foot. The numbers and their nouns are joined with a
non-breaking space. Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: mini-d20
  card-type: equipment
  language: de
data:
  name: Kurzschwert
  equipment-type: Waffe
  style: Leicht
  damage: 3
  reach: Nah
  price: 8 GM
  description: "Eine schlanke, einhändige Klinge aus geschmiedetem Stahl — die Wahl, wenn der Gang zu eng für mehr ist."
  reference: Regelwerk S. 16
```
